mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT refund_facts.payment_order_id, SUM(refund_facts.trusted_success) AS refund_count, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_facts.trusted_success = 1 THEN refund_facts.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN refund_facts.trusted_success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unverified_refund_count FROM ( SELECT refund_order.payment_order_id, refund_order.refund_amount, CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS trusted_success FROM t_refund_order refund_order WHERE refund_order.status = 'SUCCESS' ) refund_facts GROUP BY refund_facts.payment_order_id, CHAR_LENGTH(refund_facts.payment_order_id), CAST(refund_facts.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ) refund_summary ON refund_summary.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(refund_summary.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(refund_summary.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256))

LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.id = ( SELECT latest_pr.id FROM t_prepay_order latest_pr WHERE latest_pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(latest_pr.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(latest_pr.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_prepay_order all_prepay WHERE all_prepay.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(all_prepay.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(all_prepay.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256))) = 1 ORDER BY latest_pr.created_at DESC, latest_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

LEFT JOIN t_payment_attempt pa ON pa.id = ( SELECT latest_pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt latest_pa WHERE latest_pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(latest_pa.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(latest_pa.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) ORDER BY latest_pa.created_at DESC, latest_pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

LEFT JOIN t_payment_event pe ON pe.id = ( SELECT latest_pe.id FROM t_payment_event latest_pe WHERE latest_pe.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(latest_pe.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(latest_pe.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) AND latest_pe.event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' ORDER BY latest_pe.created_at DESC, latest_pe.id DESC LIMIT 1 )

CASE WHEN LEFT(pr.pay_scene, CHAR_LENGTH('WALLET_RECHARGE_')) = 'WALLET_RECHARGE_' THEN '充值支付' WHEN LEFT(pr.pay_scene, CHAR_LENGTH('WITHDRAW_REPAY_')) = 'WITHDRAW_REPAY_' THEN '提现补款' WHEN LEFT(pr.pay_scene, CHAR_LENGTH('ACCOUNT_TRANSFER_')) = 'ACCOUNT_TRANSFER_' THEN '转账补款' WHEN LEFT(pr.pay_scene, CHAR_LENGTH('BALANCE_PAY_')) = 'BALANCE_PAY_' THEN '余额补款' WHEN LEFT(pr.pay_scene, CHAR_LENGTH('HOME_')) = 'HOME_' THEN '消费支付' ELSE '未分类' END

CASE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_prepay_order all_prepay WHERE all_prepay.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id AND CHAR_LENGTH(all_prepay.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) AND CAST(all_prepay.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256))) WHEN 0 THEN 'PREPAY_BINDING_MISSING' WHEN 1 THEN NULL ELSE 'MULTIPLE_PREPAY_BINDINGS' END AS prepayBindingIssue

CASE WHEN pr.expires_at IS NULL OR pr.created_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, pr.created_at, pr.expires_at), 3600) = 0 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_at, pr.expires_at), '小时') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, pr.created_at, pr.expires_at), '秒') END
CASE WHEN p.channel_transaction_no IS NOT NULL THEN '渠道交易号' END
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id AS serialNo, p.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, p.order_no AS businessOrderNo, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, , pa.attempt_no AS paymentRequestNo, pa.source_app_id AS applicationSourceId, NULL AS businessLineId, p.channel_transaction_no AS externalTransactionNo, pa.gateway_code AS paymentGateway, p.channel_code AS paymentChannel, AS paymentType, CASE p.status WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN '支付中' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' WHEN 'FAIL' THEN '支付失败' ELSE p.status END AS paymentStatus, NULL AS bankName, NULL AS cardNo, p.last_channel_return_code AS channelReturnCode, AS returnParameterType, p.channel_transaction_no AS parameterValue, AS validityPeriod, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(p.amount, 2)) AS paymentAmount, COALESCE(refund_summary.refund_count, 0) AS refundCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(refund_summary.refunded_amount, 0), 2)) AS refundedAmount, COALESCE(refund_summary.unverified_refund_count, 0) AS unverifiedRefundCount, NULL AS productName, NULL AS userPaymentChannelId, NULL AS receivingAccount, NULL AS notifyUrl, pe.event_topic AS callbackMqTopic, DATE_FORMAT(pr.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireTime, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paidAt, NULL AS userId, p.status_type AS statusType, pa.attempt_status AS latestAttemptStatus, pa.attempt_status_type AS latestAttemptStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(pa.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestAttemptCompletedAt,
FROM t_payment_order p
(p.channel_code LIKE 'wx%' OR p.payment_method = '微信' OR p.channel_code LIKE 'alipay%' OR p.payment_method = '支付宝')
(p.channel_code LIKE '%bank%' OR p.payment_method = '银行卡')
AND p.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.userIdLikePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND p.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.businessOrderNoLikePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND = #{query.paymentType}
AND ( CASE p.status WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN '支付中' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' WHEN 'FAIL' THEN '支付失败' ELSE p.status END ) = #{query.paymentStatus}
AND p.channel_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.paymentChannelLikePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
LIMIT 1001

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order p
(p.channel_code LIKE 'wx%' OR p.payment_method = '微信' OR p.channel_code LIKE 'alipay%' OR p.payment_method = '支付宝')
(p.channel_code LIKE '%bank%' OR p.payment_method = '银行卡')
AND p.customer_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.userIdLikePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND p.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.businessOrderNoLikePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND = #{query.paymentType}
AND ( CASE p.status WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN '支付中' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' WHEN 'FAIL' THEN '支付失败' ELSE p.status END ) = #{query.paymentStatus}
AND p.channel_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.paymentChannelLikePattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'

SELECT p.id AS serialNo, p.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, p.order_no AS businessOrderNo, pr.pay_scene AS payScene, , pa.attempt_no AS paymentRequestNo, pa.source_app_id AS applicationSourceId, NULL AS businessLineId, p.channel_transaction_no AS externalTransactionNo, pa.gateway_code AS paymentGateway, p.channel_code AS paymentChannel, COALESCE(pa.payment_method, p.payment_method) AS paymentMethod, AS paymentType, CASE p.status WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '支付成功' WHEN 'WAIT_CALLBACK' THEN '支付中' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' WHEN 'FAIL' THEN '支付失败' ELSE p.status END AS paymentStatus, NULL AS bankName, NULL AS cardNo, p.last_channel_return_code AS channelReturnCode, AS returnParameterType, p.channel_transaction_no AS parameterValue, AS validityPeriod, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(p.amount, 2)) AS paymentAmount, COALESCE(refund_summary.refund_count, 0) AS refundCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(refund_summary.refunded_amount, 0), 2)) AS refundedAmount, COALESCE(refund_summary.unverified_refund_count, 0) AS unverifiedRefundCount, NULL AS productName, NULL AS userPaymentChannelId, NULL AS receivingAccount, NULL AS notifyUrl, pe.event_topic AS callbackMqTopic, DATE_FORMAT(pr.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expireTime, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paidAt, NULL AS userId, p.status_type AS statusType, pa.terminal AS latestTerminal, pa.client_ip AS latestClientIp, pa.idempotency_key AS latestIdempotencyKey, pa.attempt_status AS latestAttemptStatus, pa.attempt_status_type AS latestAttemptStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(pa.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestAttemptCompletedAt, pa.request_payload AS latestRequestPayload, pa.response_payload AS latestResponsePayload,
FROM t_payment_order p
WHERE p.payment_order_id = #{paymentOrderId} AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.payment_order_id) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{paymentOrderId}) AND CAST(p.payment_order_id AS BINARY(256)) = CAST(#{paymentOrderId} AS BINARY(256)) LIMIT 1
